title: A Space After the Name
author: The local archive of {city_name}
text: We leave a space after every traveler's name. Some say the old archive in {dungeon_name} did the same. Your guild goes to places the rest of us only talk about. Would you copy our register, read theirs, and tell me what you find?
ledger_prompt: Copy the returning-name account from the town book in {city_name} before setting out.
inscription: At departure the name is entered. At return the traveler may add a name or leave the second line empty.
finding: Both registers let the traveler choose what to write on returning. Both allow the line to stay empty.
completion: They left the choice to the traveler too. Good. I was hoping we hadn't forgotten something kind.
